# Swarm node component contracts

The fixture preserves eight complete Nivo 0.99.0 source files, its package
manifest and complete MIT license. Source, producer and existing pinned TSX
compiler hashes are checked before reexecution.

The producer executes original computed-node preparation and augmentation,
the full `Circles` creation recipe, default `CircleSvg` JSX, transition helpers,
seven event-handler paths and the parent circles-layer condition. Twenty
profiles cover animation on/off, interaction on/off and all five transition
poses, producing 80 original component creation configurations. Eight additional
cases execute the original Canvas default renderer on a command-recording
proxy; they are not browser Canvas pixels or CSS-color parsing tests.

Computed positions and simulation indices are authored. Synchronous hooks,
accessors, colors, scalar `.to`, tooltip and JSX recording are explicit probes.
This does not execute React lifecycle, Spring scheduling, D3 force simulation,
browser event transport or framebuffer equivalence. Existing numerical layout
and real Canvas references remain separate.

Original component creation does not filter zero size, transparent color,
off-viewport positions or noninteractive nodes. The layer gate is separate;
interaction controls seven optional handlers. The `from` and `leave` poses use
zero radius/opacity; initial, enter and update use size/2 and opacity one. Interpolated
negative radius clamps to zero. Original raw datum is shallow-cloned and may
contain a numeric or Date value; this is not a nullable-value API.

Kartis retains its own actual-site eligibility, hidden/cull behavior, stable
source indices, fixed-scale packing and accepted typed-data contract. A live
Glory Widget is not a React or Spring component. Rust labels are source metadata
and do not imply an upstream independent Swarm label component.

After installing pinned project packages, verification needs no checkout, Git,
network or writes:

```sh
node scripts/swarm-node-widget-reference.mjs --frozen
```

An optional fixture directory follows `--frozen`. Regeneration is separate:

```sh
node scripts/swarm-node-widget-reference.mjs <nivo-checkout> [output-directory]
```
